issue.title: filememo: Forget closes a channel another synctest bubble made, so internal/provider crashes on main since 091153bf
issue.body:
091153bf (#3185) 之后 main 的 CI 在 ubuntu 和 macOS 上都是红的，internal/provider 整个包直接崩掉：

```
fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble

goroutine 6908 [running, synctest bubble 2]:
github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/filememo.Forget()
	internal/filememo/filememo.go:91
github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/provider.Changed()
	internal/provider/hold.go:146
github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/provider.writeLogins(...)
	internal/provider/logins.go:272
...
github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/provider.TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials.func1.1(...)
	internal/provider/logins_unread_test.go:63
```

本地在 8299409e 上单跑 `go test -run '^TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials$' ./internal/provider/` 4 次崩 4 次（go1.26.8）。CI 的 Test 在 8299409e 和 81a58d2f 上也是这个。

原因：`Forget` 现在会 `close(written)` 再 `written = make(chan struct{})`。这个测试每个子测试跑在自己的 synctest bubble 里，第一个 bubble 里的 Forget 造出来的新 channel 属于那个 bubble；第二个 bubble 里的 Forget 再去 close 它，synctest 直接 fatal。生产代码不在 bubble 里，用户那边没事，只是测试。

我在修：channel 只在有循环来要（`Written`）的时候才造，`Forget` 有就关、没有就不碰。这样没人在等的写（现在所有在 bubble 里写设置的测试都是）既不造也不关 channel，等着的循环照样被下一次写叫醒。补丁一会儿贴这里。

## What main's CI does

Since 091153bf (#3185) gave bubbles something to write, main's CI is red on ubuntu and macOS with the whole `internal/provider` package dead:

```
fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble
```

Every test of the package dies with it, on every OS, and takes the rest of the run down. The issue's stack runs `Forget` (`internal/filememo/filememo.go:91`) from `provider.Changed` (`hold.go:146`) under `writeLogins` (`logins.go:272`) in `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials`.

## A two-bubble repro

The new test `TestForgetInAnotherBubble` in `internal/filememo` is the minimal shape: `Forget` in one synctest bubble, `Forget` in another, then a third bubble that waits on `Written` and wakes. Without the change it dies with the fatal above — reproduced here by reverting only `internal/filememo/filememo.go` to 385ce789, the test kept; with the change, green. The issue's own repro dies the same way under the same revert: `go test -run '^TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials$' ./internal/provider/` prints the fatal with the issue's stack verbatim — `Forget` (filememo.go:91) → `Changed` (hold.go:146) → `writeLogins` (logins.go:272).

## Why it dies

`Forget` closed the package-level `written` channel and made the next one in the same breath. A test's writes run in a synctest bubble, so the channel a bubble's write made belonged to that bubble — and it stayed behind in the package variable after the bubble was done. The next write, in another bubble, closed it outside the bubble that owned it, and synctest kills the process for that. Closing a channel made outside any bubble is fine from inside one; only a bubble's own channel closed elsewhere is fatal — so the first write poisoned every later one, the whole package's tests, until the end of the run.

## The fix

The one the issue sketches: `Written` makes the channel the first time someone waits on it, and `Forget` closes it only when it is there, leaving nothing behind — a write with no one waiting makes and closes no channel. The three loops that wait (#3185's middleware wait, the usage exporter, the plugin config refresher — each takes a fresh `Written` after every wake) see the same behavior as before: closed by the next write, the next wait open; `Gen` moves on every write as before. Consumers re-checked here: `rg` finds the waiters in `internal/middleware/points.go`, `internal/otlp/otel_sessions.go` and `internal/pluginrt/config.go`, and every `Forget` caller is a writer.

## Verification

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| `go test -count=1 ./internal/filememo/` at 5c95f305 | ok 2.2s, `TestForgetInAnotherBubble` in it |
| `go test -count=1 ./internal/provider/` at 5c95f305 | ok 76.0s — the package the issue reports dead |
| the new test with only `internal/filememo/filememo.go` reverted to 385ce789 | `fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble`, `Forget` at filememo.go:91 in synctest bubble 2 |
| the issue's repro under the same revert | the same fatal, the issue's stack verbatim (Forget → Changed → writeLogins) |
| `go vet -tags nogui`, GOOS=darwin, linux, windows | clean |
| `go build -tags nogui`, GOOS=linux, darwin, windows | clean |
| `gofmt -l` over every tracked .go file | empty |
| CI race set, sampled: gateway race binary shard 0 of 8 (307 tests), `go test -race ./internal/redact/`, provider `-run '^Test(LoginUsage|SubscriptionUsageEachAccount)'` under `-race` | pass, no race |
| `go test -race ./internal/provider/`, whole package, at 5c95f305 | one race the fix does not touch — pre-existing, below |

**A pre-existing race, disclosed in the commit and re-confirmed here**: `TestSignInDoneOnceTheAccountIsBack/fakeco` writes the package-level `catalog.Changed` (`signin_removed_test.go:112`) while a `plugin.tell` goroutine reads it through `catalog.Touched` (`host.go:671`). Under `-race` the single test hits it on bare 385ce789 too (2 of 3 runs here) — present before this patch, outside the race set CI runs, reachable only now that the package lives past the crash.

Runs on darwin/arm64, go1.26.8. The full `go test -count=1 ./...` and the whole gateway shard grid are the commit's own record; this comment samples them.

已修，分支 [`fix/r25-filememo-forget-bubble`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/r25-filememo-forget-bubble)（基于 19253f67bca2310c32739a6eaac88546b3574dbc，单提交 3a0b4479）。

**根因**：#3185 之后 `internal/filememo` 的 `Forget()`（filememo.go:91）在锁内 `close(written)` 再 `written = make(chan struct{})`。`written` 是包级变量，第一个 synctest bubble 里的 `Forget` 把新 channel 造在了那个 bubble 里；`internal/provider` 的 `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials` 每个子测试各跑一个 bubble，第二个 bubble 里 `provider.Changed()`（hold.go:146）→ `writeLogins`（logins.go:272）→ `Forget` 去 close 它，运行时直接 `fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble`，整个包的测试进程崩掉。生产代码不在 bubble 里，用户侧无影响，纯属测试崩溃。

**改法**：与楼主的思路一致——channel 只在有人等的时候才存在。`Written()` 首次被调用才 `make`；`Forget` 里有就 `close` 并置回 nil，没有就完全不碰。没有等待者的写（bubble 里跑的测试正是这种）既不造也不关 channel；等着的循环拿到的 channel 仍由下一次写关掉叫醒，"a wait begun after it waits for the one after" 的语义不变（原有 `TestWritten` 原样通过）。改动只有 `internal/filememo/filememo.go` 一处生产代码。

- 绿证：修复后同一测试通过，`go test ./internal/filememo/` 全绿。

```

go test -count=1 ./internal/provider/    ok 43.0s   (原崩溃测试在内)

go build ./...                           exit 0
GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -tags nogui ./...   exit 0
GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build ./...             exit 0
gofmt -l internal/filememo internal/provider         无输出
```

**没试的**：没在 macOS 上跑（本地只有 linux/windows 构建，mac CI 的崩溃未本地复现）；分支基于 19253f67，upstream main 上更新的 7 个提交（de49433f 等）给 filememo 加了 `wake()`，用的是同一个 `close(written)+make` 模式，落到 main 时需要同样改成懒创建；GUI 端到端未跑（本修复不触 UI 路径）。


---

**2026-10-27 跟进：分支已并入最新 main，`wake()` 同步改为懒关闭**。上游 `de49433f`（#3185）给 filememo 加了 `wake()`（Watch 看到其他进程写文件时唤醒等待循环），用的是与 `Forget` 相同的 `close(written)` + 重造模式——正如 @JoeyWu-tech 在楼上指出、其补丁 `0576b589` 已一并覆盖的，只改 `Forget` 在当前 main 上不再完整。分支现已 merge upstream/main（`d9a8148d`）并把 `wake()` 改成同样的"有人等才造、关闭即置 nil"，新头 [`47eb5102`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/47eb5102a58e7d931ab57bffa350124fadcbdc6e)（普通推送，未强推；净 diff 对 main 只剩 filememo 一处 + 回归测试）。

新红绿（go1.26.8，linux/amd64）：

- 红：干净 `d9a8148d` + 仅加 `TestWakeAcrossSynctestBubbles` → `fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble`，栈顶 `wake()` filememo.go:101（新增的第二个关闭点）；
- 绿：分支头 `filememo` 包全绿；原崩溃测试 `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials` 通过；`vet` / `build`（linux、windows、nogui）/ `gofmt` 全过。

**一个如实的边界**：分支头满包跑 `internal/provider` 时，`TestOpenCodeSessionOnEveryCall` 出现顺序/负载相关红——`openCodeNewID` 的每毫秒计数器越过 15 后，自己刚生成的 id 过不了 `openCodeRealSession` 的低位校验（失败样本计数器已到 ~1006）。该测试单独跑、`TestOpenCode*` 家族 `-count=3` 全绿；干净 main 跳过崩溃测试的满包复跑同样出现过这个红（两次一绿一红），且本分支净 diff 不触任何 provider 文件，判定为 main 既有负载 flake，与本改动无关，但满包并非全绿，如实记下。

commit 0576b589，基于 origin/main c158b043（现在的 77f86010 上也能直接打），`git format-patch --no-signature --full-index --stdout c158b043..0576b589 | sha256sum` 是 `8066424dc3e62c1866ead2f936f2bea3a12ba4824bc8032bbd63c7e972db0802`。

说好一会儿贴，结果拖到现在，抱歉。main 的 CI 到现在还红在这：最新跑完的 5a94eec3（run 40312323563）ubuntu 和 macOS 上 provider 都是这个 fatal。本地 c158b043 上跑 4 次 4 次都是。

改法和上面说的一样：`Written` 手上没有 channel 时才造，写的时候只关被拿走的那个，自己不造。多出来的一处是 de49433f 加的 `wake()`（Watch 看到别的进程写文件时叫醒循环），里面也是先 close 再 make，所以两处一起改，共用一个 `endWaits`。只改 `Forget` 的话，`written` 为 nil 时 `wake` 会 close(nil) panic。

新 main 上拿 `Written` 的循环多了 awake 和 agent 的 Codex daemon，我在 `Forget`/`wake`/`Written` 里重新加了临时探针，把带 synctest 的包和这五个循环所在的包都跑了一遍，bubble 里没有任何地方拿 `Written`。provider、plugin、filememo 的测试二进制也根本不链接这五个循环。

`TestWrittenAcrossBubbles` 把 `Forget` 和 `wake` 分开，各跑两个 bubble，bubble 外面先拿两个等待。手工破坏了五种：换回 c158b043 的 filememo.go、`Forget` 重新造 channel、`wake` 改回先 close 再 make，都是同一个 fatal error；`Written` 每次都造新的，两个等待有一个叫不醒；去掉 nil 判断是 `close of nil channel`。改完 `-race -shuffle=on -count=20` 是绿的，provider 整包（Bun 1.4.2）也是绿的。全量绕开 graftcp 跑过，provider 是 ok 的，别的红都有 issue，commit body 里逐个列了。

gateway 的 claudeRoom 也是先 close 再 make 的写法，现在没有 bubble 走到它，单独开了 #3690。

@ggbdpq 你的 5c95f305 和我原来那版是同一个改法，我在 Linux 上验证过（5c95f305 加上我这个测试的 `Forget` 那一半：filememo `-race -shuffle=on -count=20`、provider 整包 Bun 1.4.2 都过，换回旧的 filememo.go 也是同一个 fatal）。不过 de49433f 合进来以后它打不上了，`wake()` 也得一起改。skygunner 后来贴的 3a0b4479 也是同一个改法，基于更早的 19253f67，同样没改 `wake()`（skygunner 的评论里也提到了），现在的 77f86010 上两个都打不上（`git apply --check` 都停在 filememo.go:88）。用哪个 yetone 定。

I re-checked all three patches against today's main (1bb8143b), and the ground moved under the first two: de49433f (#3185) landed after they were written and added a second close site. `wake` — which wakes the loops waiting on Written when Watch sees another process's write — closes and remakes the channel just as Forget does (`internal/filememo/filememo.go:99-104` on 1bb8143b). A fix that guards Forget only is not complete on current main.

Timeline, for the record: my patch (5c95f305, posted 10-25 19:38 UTC) predates de49433f (committed 10-26 03:22 UTC), which is why it covers one face and not two. Cherry-picking it onto 1bb8143b shows the gap concretely: the Forget guard merges cleanly, and the conflict sits exactly over `wake` and the package `written` var; resolving it with that patch's lazy-Written semantics while leaving `wake` as main has it ends with `wake` closing a channel nobody has taken yet — a probe that calls `wake` first thing panics with `close of nil channel` at its close. skygunner's 3a0b4479 has the same shape and the same gap: its base (19253f67) predates de49433f, its tree has no `wake` at all, and on today's main it fails the same way. The issue itself is still live on clean 1bb8143b: TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials dies with `fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble` in the second bubble.

JoeyWu's patch (0576b589, base c158b043, which includes de49433f) fixes both faces: Forget and wake share one endWaits, which closes the channel only if one was taken since the last write and makes none; the new TestWrittenAcrossBubbles drives the write through Forget and through wake, each in a bubble of its own, with both waits taken outside the bubbles. I verified it directly (cherry-picked onto 1bb8143b — applies clean, internal/filememo is unchanged between the two bases) on darwin/arm64, Go 1.26.8:

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| clean 1bb8143b, TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials | FAIL: `fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble` — still live on main |
| 0576b589 on 1bb8143b, `go test -count=1 ./internal/filememo/` | ok — TestWrittenAcrossBubbles (Forget and wake), TestWritten, TestWatchWakesOnOthersWrites |
| 0576b589 on 1bb8143b, TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials + TestReadableLoginsNotKeptAside | ok |
| endWaits semantics vs. the waiters | compatible: each of the five production loops takes a fresh Written at the top of its iteration (middleware `points.go:409,424`, OTel `otel_sessions.go:116,133`, pluginrt `config.go:379`, the Codex daemon check `codex_daemon.go:93,102`, awake `awake.go:105`), and a grep over the tree finds `filememo.Written()` in no test outside internal/filememo — so none is taken inside a bubble |

So: JoeyWu's patch is the complete fix on current main, and I recommend it as the one to take. Mine and skygunner's are superseded — my branch (`hunt86-r10-3632-synctest`) stays on my fork for the record and is withdrawn as a candidate. Thanks to JoeyWu for reporting this and then closing it properly, and to skygunner: an independent, same-shaped fix within hours is good corroboration of the root cause.

## What main's CI does

Since 091153bf (#3185) gave bubbles something to write, main's CI is red on ubuntu and macOS with the whole `internal/provider` package dead:

```
fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble
```

Every test of the package dies with it, on every OS, and takes the rest of the run down. The issue's stack runs `Forget` (`internal/filememo/filememo.go:91`) from `provider.Changed` (`hold.go:146`) under `writeLogins` (`logins.go:272`) in `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials`.

## A two-bubble repro

The new test `TestForgetInAnotherBubble` in `internal/filememo` is the minimal shape: `Forget` in one synctest bubble, `Forget` in another, then a third bubble that waits on `Written` and wakes. Without the change it dies with the fatal above — reproduced here by reverting only `internal/filememo/filememo.go` to 385ce789, the test kept; with the change, green. The issue's own repro dies the same way under the same revert: `go test -run '^TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials$' ./internal/provider/` prints the fatal with the issue's stack verbatim — `Forget` (filememo.go:91) → `Changed` (hold.go:146) → `writeLogins` (logins.go:272).

## Why it dies

`Forget` closed the package-level `written` channel and made the next one in the same breath. A test's writes run in a synctest bubble, so the channel a bubble's write made belonged to that bubble — and it stayed behind in the package variable after the bubble was done. The next write, in another bubble, closed it outside the bubble that owned it, and synctest kills the process for that. Closing a channel made outside any bubble is fine from inside one; only a bubble's own channel closed elsewhere is fatal — so the first write poisoned every later one, the whole package's tests, until the end of the run.

The one the issue sketches: `Written` makes the channel the first time someone waits on it, and `Forget` closes it only when it is there, leaving nothing behind — a write with no one waiting makes and closes no channel. The three loops that wait (#3185's middleware wait, the usage exporter, the plugin config refresher — each takes a fresh `Written` after every wake) see the same behavior as before: closed by the next write, the next wait open; `Gen` moves on every write as before. ## The problem In Settings › Observability, once the OTLP endpoint and headers are filled in, nothing says whether they work. A wrong key, a host without `/api/public/otel`, or `http://` where the collector redirects to `https://` all end the same way: `otel: traces export failed; batch dropped` in the log, and nothing in the collector. The only check is to send real traffic and go look in Langfuse. An SSH or database client has a Test connection button for this; Observability has none. ## What the branch does **Test connection**, a row under OTLP headers on the Collector connection card, with a Test button. It sends an **empty export** (`{"resourceSpans":[]}`, and `{"resourceMetrics":[]}` when Export metrics is on), so the collector checks the endpoint and headers and records nothing. The lines under the row say what it met: | Answer | What the row says | | --- | --- | | 2xx | Works: `` took a test export in N ms | | 401 / 403 | `` refused the headers (401): check the keys, and that they are for this host, then *The collector says: …* | | 404 / 405, or a web page answering | No collector answers at `` (404): check the endpoint's path. Langfuse's ends in /api/public/otel | | 3xx | `` redirects to `
`, and exports don't follow redirects: use that address as the endpoint | | other status | `` answered 503, then the collector's own message | | no connection | Couldn't reach ``: dial tcp: lookup …: no such host | | no answer in 3s | `` didn't answer within 3 seconds, so an export there would be dropped | Every string is in zh, zh-TW, ja and de. ## How it works, and why it says what an export would meet - `otlp.Check` sends the empty export **by the exporter's own code**. `otelClient` (the proxy in force, 3s, no redirect followed), `signalURL` and `exportRequest` were pulled out of `send` and are shared with it; `send`'s behaviour is unchanged, and the existing exporter tests pass as they were. - `POST /api/otel/test` tries `settings.OTelExport()`: the saved settings under any `MAGPIE_OTEL_*`, which is what the exporter sends to, with export **on or off** (so it can be tried before turning export on). It **takes no endpoint or headers from the request**, so the route can't be used to send the saved credentials anywhere else. The page waits for a field's pending save (`prefsQueue`) before it asks, so a value typed and not yet saved is the one tested. - Header values (whole, each long word, and Basic's decoded user and password) are taken out of anything the collector says back. HTML answers are never shown. - An unreadable `settings.json` is said as such, not as "no endpoint" (`settings.LoadChecked` first). - No new destination: the request goes only to the collector the user configured, with the headers they configured for it. ## Checked against the real Langfuse Cloud (US) The built binary (`magpie web`, `-tags nogui`) in a sandbox HOME, with its own gateway port, `MAGPIE_NO_ACCOUNTS=1` and `DO_NOT_TRACK=1`, never the running magpie: | Saved settings | `POST /api/otel/test` answered | | --- | --- | | correct keys, export Off | `200`, "Works" in ~260 ms | | wrong secret key | `401` auth, "Invalid credentials. Confirm that you've configured the correct host." | | host without `/api/public/otel` | `404` path (Langfuse's HTML 404 page, not shown) | | `http://` instead of `https://` | `301` redirect, suggests `https://us.cloud.langfuse.com:443/api/public/otel`; saving that address → `200` | | Export metrics on | traces `200`, metrics `200` | | a host that doesn't resolve | network, "dial tcp: lookup …: no such host" | | nothing saved | 400 "Set the OTLP endpoint first" | - **The collector records nothing:** after three Tests, Langfuse's `GET /api/public/v2/observations` for that window returned 0 observations, while the same query over the hours before returns the project's real gateway traces. - **The secret never comes back:** neither the secret key nor its base64 appears in any answer. - **The real page:** driven in Chromium against the sandbox, with a wrong header typed (not saved) and Test clicked: the field was saved first, then tested, and the 401 and Langfuse's message showed. Screenshots below. ## The branch - Diff against main: https://github.com/yetone/magpie/compare/main...0xJchen:magpie:otel-test-connection - One commit, rebased on main `7499ebb5`: https://github.com/0xJchen/magpie/commit/7d9f65d30672 ```sh git fetch https://github.com/0xJchen/magpie.git otel-test-connection git cherry-pick 7d9f65d30672 ``` 14 files, +933 −15: `internal/otlp/check.go` (new), `internal/otlp/otel.go` (helpers shared with `send`), `internal/gui/oteltest.go` (new route), `internal/gui/api.go` (registration), `app.js` / `app.css` / `i18n.js` (the row), tests, `docs/reference.md` (OTLP export) and `docs/subsystems/plugin-runtime.md` (`plugins/otel`). **app.js size:** the row adds 2,769 bytes to app.js, and `TestCoreScriptBudget`'s two budgets are raised by exactly that, with the reason in their comments, as for other Settings rows. If you'd rather Observability's section moved into `plugins/otel`'s own client files first, I can do that as a separate commit. ## What was run (at 7d9f65d30, on main 7499ebb5) Go under a sandbox HOME, on go1.26.8 (go.mod's and CI's): - `gofmt -l` on the changed files prints nothing. `go vet ./...` for darwin, `GOOS=linux -tags nogui` and `GOOS=windows`, plus the three builds: ok. - **New tests:** `TestCheck*` (5, `-race`) and `TestOTelTest*` (3) pass. `otel-check.test.cjs` passes 12 of 12 in Chromium and in WebKit, in every language, at 1100 and 420 px wide. - **Each guarantee broken by hand,** with its test red, then restored: - headers dropped; - redirects followed; - proxy ignored; - a URL built apart from `signalURL`; - metrics skipped; - a 2xx web page taken as working; - header values not scrubbed; - a timeout read as a network fault; - `LoadChecked` dropped; - the request's endpoint taken; - `MAGPIE_OTEL_*` ignored; - the page not waiting for a pending save; - an answer kept after the endpoint changes; - the collector's words dropped; - the page as it is on main. - **`go test -tags nogui -timeout 45m ./...`:** 70 packages ok. **根因**：#3185 之后 `internal/filememo` 的 `Forget()`（filememo.go:91）在锁内 `close(written)` 再 `written = make(chan struct{})`。`written` 是包级变量，第一个 synctest bubble 里的 `Forget` 把新 channel 造在了那个 bubble 里；`internal/provider` 的 `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials` 每个子测试各跑一个 bubble，第二个 bubble 里 `provider.Changed()`（hold.go:146）→ `writeLogins`（logins.go:272）→ `Forget` 去 close 它，运行时直接 `fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble`，整个包的测试进程崩掉。生产代码不在 bubble 里，用户侧无影响，纯属测试崩溃。

issue.title: gateway: TestPluginToldWhereTheAgentWorks fails when an empty .git sits above TMPDIR (GitOnDisk takes it as a repository)

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
On main c158b043 this test fails on every run here: 5 of 5 with `-count=5`, Bun 1.4.2, Go 1.26.8 on linux/amd64, umask 077, run outside the box's graftcp proxy.

```
--- FAIL: TestPluginToldWhereTheAgentWorks (0.21s)
    plugin_workdir_test.go:110: not in one: the plugin was told "/tmp/TestPluginToldWhereTheAgentWorks4021958867/005", git "yes"; want "/tmp/TestPluginToldWhereTheAgentWorks4021958867/005", "no"
```

Only the "not in one" case fails, and on the git answer rather than the request count, so this isn't #3347 coming back.

It's the same empty /tmp/.git as #3641. GitOnDisk walks up from the folder and counts any .git it finds as a repository, so every t.TempDir() under /tmp comes out "yes". Git doesn't count an empty one: `git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree` in a folder under it says "not a git repository". Moving TMPDIR shows that's all it is. With TMPDIR=/var/tmp/toldwhere-clean, which has no .git above it, the same run passes 5 of 5. With an empty /var/tmp/toldwhere-git/.git and TMPDIR=/var/tmp/toldwhere-git, it fails 5 of 5 with the same line.

So a machine with a .git anywhere above its temp folder gets this red. One thing for whoever fixes it: the "in a repository" case also makes its repo from an empty .git, so if GitOnDisk starts asking for a real repository, that fixture needs a real one too.

issue.title: awake: Keep takes Written after it reads the setting, so Keep awake turned on in between waits for the next beat (up to a minute while Watch runs)

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Came up while reviewing #3632. Keep's loop reads the level first (`l := level()`, which is `settings.Load` in the gateway) and only takes `filememo.Written()` after it, when the level came back Off. The other loops that wait on Written (middleware's observer, OTel's session watch, `pluginrt.KeepFresh`, the Codex daemon check) take it before they look, for this reason. The order is from 250adf5e.

So if Keep awake gets turned on between that read and `Written()`, the save's Forget closes the channel from before, and Keep then waits on a fresh one until its beat, `filememo.OthersEvery()`: 5s when polling, a minute while Watch runs. (With the watch, the file event of the same save still wakes it if that comes after `Written()`.) A write from the CLI or a second magpie, which only the watch reports, has the same window.

The window is small, from Load's unlock to `Written()`, a bit wider only while `let()` is letting go of a hold. So it's rare, but when it hits, the hold the user just turned on waits up to a minute. In a test where Keep's level func makes that write right after its read, Keep on 098ac969 holds 2.4 to 5.0s later, at the beat, 5 of 5. With Written taken before the look it holds at once. Patch coming here.

issue.title: gateway: claudeRoom remakes its freed channel the way filememo did before #3632, so a Claude Code run in a synctest bubble would crash the next release outside it

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Came up in the review of #3632. `claudeRoomT.release` closes `c.freed` and makes the next one every time a Claude Code process ends, and `nudge` does the same while an ask waits for room. `claudeRoom` is a package-level var, so if a test ever runs a Claude Code turn inside a synctest bubble, the next `freed` belongs to that bubble. The next release outside it (or an ask that waits on it, or a nudge) is then a fatal error, and it takes the whole gateway test binary down in whichever test runs Claude Code next.

Nothing hits it today: gateway's only synctest tests are TestConcurrentClassification*, which call classify with a fake ask. That's how filememo looked before a provider test wrote in a bubble. A take and release in a bubble, then one outside it, shows it on 098ac969:

```
fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble

goroutine 210 [running]:
github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/gateway.(*claudeRoomT).release(...)
	internal/gateway/claude_room.go:294
```

The fix would be the same as for filememo: make `freed` only when an ask has to wait, and have release and nudge close it only if one was taken. trace's `wake` already works that way. I'll put a patch here.

issue.title: pii: a masking request in a synctest bubble would leave srv.stop and the idle timer tied to it, and the next Stop outside it crashes

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Came up in the review of #3690. pii's `srv` is package-level, and two of its fields are made by whoever gets there first: `stopCh()` makes `srv.stop` on classifyTurn's first look and keeps it until Stop, and `idleLocked` makes `srv.idle` after each answered request. If a test ever runs a masking request inside a synctest bubble, both belong to that bubble, and the next `Stop()` outside it, or the next answered request, touching them is a fatal error that takes the test binary down.

Nothing hits it today: pii and masking have no synctest tests, and gateway's bubbles (TestConcurrentClassification*) never reach masking. A probe on 27ca0bef, `stopCh()` in a bubble and then `Stop()` outside it:

```
fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble
	internal/pii/serve.go:245
```

and `idleLocked` in a bubble, then `detachLocked` outside it (what Stop does):

```
fatal error: stop of synctest timer from outside bubble
	internal/pii/serve.go:270
```

Same family as #3632 and #3690. I'm leaving it out of the #3690 patch since it's another package, so it's here for whoever first puts pii or masking in a bubble.

issue.title: [bug] sessions: a Claude Code fork subagent's copy of its parent's reply is counted twice (branch ready; PRs are collaborators-only)

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Branch: [fish2lab/magpie `sessions-claude-fork-copy`](https://github.com/fish2lab/magpie/tree/sessions-claude-fork-copy), one commit, [df11f97](https://github.com/fish2lab/magpie/commit/df11f97d0e16279d889b0f0da8a353b6d903661d), on origin/main 7d075df. I'm filing it as an issue because PRs here are limited to collaborators.

```
git fetch https://github.com/fish2lab/magpie sessions-claude-fork-copy && git cherry-pick df11f97
```

## What's wrong

A Claude Code fork subagent's transcript (`<session>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl`, here from Claude Code 2.1.302) opens with a `fork-context-ref` line. Next comes a copy of the parent's reply that started the fork, with the same `message.id` and `requestId`, now marked `isSidechain: true` with the fork's `agentId`. Then comes the fork's own prompt. The parent's main file already counts that reply, and the sessions reader dedupes calls only within a file. So `magpie sessions` and the stats count the reply once more for every fork.

## The fix

Subsystem: sessions (`internal/sessions`, the Claude Code reader). No subsystem reference documents how Claude transcripts are counted, so no page changes.

- Trigger: a `fork-context-ref` line. The reader sets `state.ForkHead` and skips assistant lines until the file's first user line. It does this both in the fast path (`claudeLine`) and in the full parse (`claudeFull`). The first user line clears the flag, and everything after it is counted as before.
- Before: the copied reply counted once in the parent's file and again in each fork's file. After: it counts once, in the parent's file.
- State: `ForkHead` is kept in the parse cache (`fork_head`), so a read that resumes inside the head still skips. `cacheVersion` goes from 22 to 23, so files parsed before are read again.
- Files without a `fork-context-ref` line read as before. These include ordinary subagents, workflow agents and main transcripts.

## Verification

Run at df11f97 (on origin/main 7d075df), go1.27.3 darwin/arm64:

- `gofmt -l` is clean.
- Vet is clean: `go vet ./...`, `GOOS=linux go vet -tags nogui ./...` and `GOOS=windows go vet ./...`.
- Builds are ok: `go build`, `GOOS=linux go build -tags nogui` and `GOOS=windows go build`.
- `go test -tags nogui -count=1 ./...` in a sandbox HOME with Go's caches pinned: 69 packages ok, including `internal/sessions` (ok, 73s). A few packages are red, and they are red in the same way on origin/main 7d075df without this change:
  - `internal/provider`: #3632 (ok in 71s with `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials` skipped)
  - `internal/gateway`: `TestMarshalRawIsEncodingJSON` and `FuzzMarshalRaw` (#3547), `TestCodexFittedImagesPastTheBudget` (#3549), `TestServeWSLListensBesideLoopback` (#3680)
  - `internal/plugin`: `TestPluginSOCKSProxy` (#2207)
- Broken by hand: I put the old `claude.go` and `sessions.go` back and kept the new test. `TestClaudeForkSubagentCountsParentReplyOnce` then fails with `session: {Input:250 Output:25 CacheRead:30 ...}, want {Input:150 Output:15 CacheRead:20 ...}`. With the change restored, it passes.

I also checked against real data. I copied one real session (its main file and its one fork) into a sandbox, with HOME, the XDG dirs and `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` all pointing there, and ran `magpie sessions --json` with binaries built from origin/main and from this branch:

| | origin/main | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| input | 238 | 236 |
| output | 153,562 | 150,944 |
| cache read | 24,171,440 | 24,041,229 |
| cache write | 388,781 | 387,933 |

The branch's numbers equal that session's calls deduped by `message.id` + `requestId` across all of its files, as counted by an independent reader, [git-tab](https://github.com/fish2lab/git-tab)'s Claude Code adapter.

Not tried:

- Cowork transcripts, which use the same reader.
- Running on Linux or Windows; only the GOOS vet and builds above were run. The change has no platform code.

## Found while checking, not changed here

I compared 115 sessions from the last 30 days against git-tab, and 100 matched to the cent. Three other differences come from magpie behavior I left alone. I can open a separate issue for any of them if useful:

- `sessions` and the stats price each model's total at its base tier (`p.At(0)` in `sessions.go` and `stats.go`). So Claude Haiku 5.5's rate for prompts above 100K tokens ($0.50/$2.50 per MTok, against $0.10/$0.50) is never applied. One pi session on Haiku 5.5 had identical tokens on both sides. It cost $0.12 in magpie, against $0.52 when each request is priced at its tier.
- DeepSeek's peak-hour price is not applied. It is 2× on weekdays 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time ([pricing page](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing)). Two pi sessions on deepseek-flash that ran entirely in peak hours came out at half their price.
- A forked or resumed Claude Code session copies its parent's history into a new main file under a new `sessionId`. Per-session totals then count the copied calls in both sessions. In one fork the copies made up 95% of its listed cost: $6.62 listed, against $0.31 for its own calls.

timeline.body:
补丁在这：https://github.com/JoeyWu-tech/magpie/tree/fix/3632-filememo-synctest

commit 0576b589，基于 origin/main c158b043（现在的 77f86010 上也能直接打），`git format-patch --no-signature --full-index --stdout c158b043..0576b589 | sha256sum` 是 `8066424dc3e62c1866ead2f936f2bea3a12ba4824bc8032bbd63c7e972db0802`。

说好一会儿贴，结果拖到现在，抱歉。main 的 CI 到现在还红在这：最新跑完的 5a94eec3（run 40312323563）ubuntu 和 macOS 上 provider 都是这个 fatal。本地 c158b043 上跑 4 次 4 次都是。

改法和上面说的一样：`Written` 手上没有 channel 时才造，写的时候只关被拿走的那个，自己不造。多出来的一处是 de49433f 加的 `wake()`（Watch 看到别的进程写文件时叫醒循环），里面也是先 close 再 make，所以两处一起改，共用一个 `endWaits`。只改 `Forget` 的话，`written` 为 nil 时 `wake` 会 close(nil) panic。

新 main 上拿 `Written` 的循环多了 awake 和 agent 的 Codex daemon，我在 `Forget`/`wake`/`Written` 里重新加了临时探针，把带 synctest 的包和这五个循环所在的包都跑了一遍，bubble 里没有任何地方拿 `Written`。provider、plugin、filememo 的测试二进制也根本不链接这五个循环。

`TestWrittenAcrossBubbles` 把 `Forget` 和 `wake` 分开，各跑两个 bubble，bubble 外面先拿两个等待。手工破坏了五种：换回 c158b043 的 filememo.go、`Forget` 重新造 channel、`wake` 改回先 close 再 make，都是同一个 fatal error；`Written` 每次都造新的，两个等待有一个叫不醒；去掉 nil 判断是 `close of nil channel`。改完 `-race -shuffle=on -count=20` 是绿的，provider 整包（Bun 1.4.2）也是绿的。全量绕开 graftcp 跑过，provider 是 ok 的，别的红都有 issue，commit body 里逐个列了。

gateway 的 claudeRoom 也是先 close 再 make 的写法，现在没有 bubble 走到它，单独开了 #3690。

@ggbdpq 你的 5c95f305 和我原来那版是同一个改法，我在 Linux 上验证过（5c95f305 加上我这个测试的 `Forget` 那一半：filememo `-race -shuffle=on -count=20`、provider 整包 Bun 1.4.2 都过，换回旧的 filememo.go 也是同一个 fatal）。不过 de49433f 合进来以后它打不上了，`wake()` 也得一起改。skygunner 后来贴的 3a0b4479 也是同一个改法，基于更早的 19253f67，同样没改 `wake()`（skygunner 的评论里也提到了），现在的 77f86010 上两个都打不上（`git apply --check` 都停在 filememo.go:88）。用哪个 yetone 定。

I re-checked all three patches against today's main (1bb8143b), and the ground moved under the first two: de49433f (#3185) landed after they were written and added a second close site. `wake` — which wakes the loops waiting on Written when Watch sees another process's write — closes and remakes the channel just as Forget does (`internal/filememo/filememo.go:99-104` on 1bb8143b). A fix that guards Forget only is not complete on current main.

Timeline, for the record: my patch (5c95f305, posted 10-25 19:38 UTC) predates de49433f (committed 10-26 03:22 UTC), which is why it covers one face and not two. Cherry-picking it onto 1bb8143b shows the gap concretely: the Forget guard merges cleanly, and the conflict sits exactly over `wake` and the package `written` var; resolving it with that patch's lazy-Written semantics while leaving `wake` as main has it ends with `wake` closing a channel nobody has taken yet — a probe that calls `wake` first thing panics with `close of nil channel` at its close. skygunner's 3a0b4479 has the same shape and the same gap: its base (19253f67) predates de49433f, its tree has no `wake` at all, and on today's main it fails the same way. The issue itself is still live on clean 1bb8143b: TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials dies with `fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble` in the second bubble.

JoeyWu's patch (0576b589, base c158b043, which includes de49433f) fixes both faces: Forget and wake share one endWaits, which closes the channel only if one was taken since the last write and makes none; the new TestWrittenAcrossBubbles drives the write through Forget and through wake, each in a bubble of its own, with both waits taken outside the bubbles. I verified it directly (cherry-picked onto 1bb8143b — applies clean, internal/filememo is unchanged between the two bases) on darwin/arm64, Go 1.26.8:

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| clean 1bb8143b, TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials | FAIL: `fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble` — still live on main |
| 0576b589 on 1bb8143b, `go test -count=1 ./internal/filememo/` | ok — TestWrittenAcrossBubbles (Forget and wake), TestWritten, TestWatchWakesOnOthersWrites |
| 0576b589 on 1bb8143b, TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials + TestReadableLoginsNotKeptAside | ok |
| endWaits semantics vs. the waiters | compatible: each of the five production loops takes a fresh Written at the top of its iteration (middleware `points.go:409,424`, OTel `otel_sessions.go:116,133`, pluginrt `config.go:379`, the Codex daemon check `codex_daemon.go:93,102`, awake `awake.go:105`), and a grep over the tree finds `filememo.Written()` in no test outside internal/filememo — so none is taken inside a bubble |

So: JoeyWu's patch is the complete fix on current main, and I recommend it as the one to take. Mine and skygunner's are superseded — my branch (`hunt86-r10-3632-synctest`) stays on my fork for the record and is withdrawn as a candidate. Thanks to JoeyWu for reporting this and then closing it properly, and to skygunner: an independent, same-shaped fix within hours is good corroboration of the root cause.

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### 环境

- magpie 0.1.1594，macOS 15.7.5
- ChatGPT App 26.1021.31345（自带 codex-cli 0.164.0-alpha.11.1）
- Codex 保留 ChatGPT 登录接入 magpie：`~/.codex/config.toml` 里有 `openai_base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:3425/backend-api/codex"` 和 `[model_providers.magpie]`，没有顶层 `model_provider`
- 两个 Codex 账号，Codex 自己登录的是 Free 号，Plus 号是在 magpie 里添加的：

```
● codex   <free 号>  · free
○ codex   <plus 号>  · plus
```

### 现象

Codex 的模型选择器里只有 Free 套餐的模型，看不到只有 Plus 才有的 `gpt-6.1-sol` 和 `gpt-6-astra`。但直接指定这两个模型，magpie 能正确转给 Plus 号，说明问题只在模型列表，不在路由。

### 证据

**1. magpie 这边有这两个模型**（`magpie provider codex`）：

```
account    <free 号>  free  from codex's own sign-in
models     4 exposed of 3 from chatgpt.com
not shown  gpt-5.6-luna · not picked
           codex/gpt-6-astra  GPT-6 Astra
           codex/gpt-6.1-sol  GPT-6.1 Sol
           codex/gpt-6-luna  GPT-6-Luna
           codex/gpt-5.6-terra  GPT-5.6-Terra
```

**2. Codex 拿到的列表里没有**（`~/.codex/models_cache.json`，`client_version` 0.164.0）。一共只有 5 项，没有任何 `codex/…` 条目：

```
gpt-6-luna         list
gpt-5.6-terra      list
gpt-5.6-luna       list
gpt-reserve        hide
codex-auto-review  hide
```

**3. 直接指定模型能用：**

```
codex exec --skip-git-repo-check -m gpt-6.1-sol "say hi"
```

请求正常返回。`magpie usage --csv` 里这条记录是：`requested_model=codex/gpt-6.1-sol`，`host=chatgpt.com as <plus 号>`，`status=200`。

不过 Codex 会提示：

```
warning: Model metadata for `gpt-6.1-sol` not found. Defaulting to fallback metadata; this can degrade performance and cause issues.
```

也就是说，列表里没有这个模型，Codex 只能用默认的上下文窗口、推理档位等参数。

### 推测（没看代码确认）

[#2582](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/2582) 里提到，保留 ChatGPT 登录时，magpie 会去掉和原生模型重名的 `codex/…` 条目。但这里 `gpt-6.1-sol`、`gpt-6-astra` 本来就不在 Free 号的原生列表里，`codex/…` 版本却也被去掉了，结果两边都没有。

### 期望

如果 Codex 登录号的套餐没有某个模型，而 magpie 里另一个已启用的 Codex 账号能用它，就把它加进 Codex 的模型列表：

- 用原生名（`gpt-6.1-sol`）显示，带上能用它的那个账号的模型元数据，这样 Codex 就不会退回默认参数；
- 选中后按现在的逻辑转给那个账号（这部分已经正常）。

issue.title: [bug] 模型 id 的区域前缀（WorkBuddy 的 cn:）让能力元数据全部落空：推理档位空、Codex 推理强度回落「中」（catalog 把第一个冒号当尾部 tag 切）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 现状

自定义 provider 指向 WorkBuddy 的代理，模型 id 是 WorkBuddy 原样给的**区域前缀 id**：`cn:deepseek-v4.1-flash`、`cn:glm-5.3-flash`。这两个模型在 models.dev 上都有档位（low、high、max，`deepseek-v4.1-flash` 的 1M 窗口也有），但 magpie 里能力元数据全部为空。

同一台机器上 Codex 的 `models_cache.json`，magpie 交给 Codex 的条目：

| slug | supported_reasoning_levels | default_reasoning_level |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `workbuddy-proxy/cn:deepseek-v4.1-flash` | **[]** | **无** |
| `workbuddy-proxy/cn:glm-5.3-flash` | **[]** | **无** |
| `wong/deepseek-v4.1-flash`（同一模型，id 干净） | low, high, max | high |

后果：Codex 桌面端认为这个模型没有推理档，忽略 config.toml 里的 `model_reasoning_effort = "high"`，界面回落「中」；magpie 的 GUI 里这条模型的窗口也是空的。

## 根因

`internal/catalog/catalog.go` 的 `found()` 把 id 里**第一个冒号**当作 OpenRouter 式的**尾部变体 tag**（`glm-5:free` → 查 `glm-5`）：

```go
if i := strings.IndexByte(b, ':'); i > 0 {
    v, ok := table[b[:i]]
    return v, ok
}
```

但 `cn:` 是模型无关的**区域前缀标记**，模型 id 在冒号**后面**。于是 `cn:deepseek-v4.1-flash` 被切成 `cn` 去查表，什么都查不到。同型的还有三处：`ListedBy` 和 `PricedBy` 的 want 列表只有 `cutAt(b, ':')`（冒号前），`KinEfforts` 的 versionless 形状也带着前缀，全都对不上。

## 修复（fork 分支已备好）

[`catalog-cn-marker-prefix`](https://github.com/NineSu/magpie/tree/catalog-cn-marker-prefix)：`found()` 在冒号前那截查不到任何模型时，把冒号后那截当模型 id 试；`ListedBy` / `PricedBy`（含 canonical 一问）/ `KinEfforts` 同样加上去前缀的候选。`glm-5.3-flash:free` 这类真尾部 tag 行为不变（tag 的 id 冒号前就是模型名，先命中）。

修复后（本机真实 models.dev 缓存验证，prefixed 与 bare 行为一致）：

```
EffortsOf("cn:deepseek-v4.1-flash") = [low high max]  ContextOf=1048576  Thinks=true
EffortsOf("cn:glm-5.3-flash")       = [low high max]  ContextOf=1000000  Thinks=true
PricedBy(alibaba-cn, cn:deepseek-v4.1-flash) = 0.29754/1.19015（与 bare id 一致）
```

## 关联

- #1383：同一类问题（relay 加前缀/后缀改名拿不到能力元数据），`claude-` 前缀和 `[1M]` 后缀两种形状已修，**冒号前缀是还没覆盖的形状**。
- #2888：Trae CN 的 deepseek v4.1 flash 窗口只有 116k（官方 agent 里可选 max 提到 1M）——症状一致，若 Trae CN 的 id 同样带区域前缀，应是同一根因，值得一并用这个视角查。
- #2655：Trae 模型全部没有推理等级（其报告里 WorkBuddy 的正常，若其 WorkBuddy 走插件返回的是干净 id，也和这里对得上）。

## 验证

TDD 红绿：TestContextOf / TestEffortsOf / TestListedBy / TestFamilyLevels / TestPricedByCanonicalID 加了 `cn:` 用例，在旧代码上全部 FAIL，修复后通过。`go test ./...`、`go test -tags nogui ./...`、`go test -race -count=2 ./internal/catalog`、`go vet`（darwin / linux nogui / windows）、`go build`（darwin / linux nogui / windows）、`gofmt -l` 全过。

@yetone 麻烦从这个分支开个 PR，谢谢！

Not taking it; it's still red on main at that sha.

issue.title: 模型探针写死 /v1/chat/completions，Responses-only 供应商的模型在 Models 列表里恒为红点

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
magpie 0.1.1610 / macOS 27.0.1

AgentRouter 的三个模型（gpt-5.6-sol、gpt-6-astra、gpt-6.1-sol）在供应商页的 Models 列表里全是红点，点 "Working only" 会把它们整个过滤掉。但这三个模型实际上是能用的，红点是探针打错了接口。

## 探针写死了 chat 端点

这三个模型只支持 Responses API，上游对 chat 接口直接拒绝：

```
模型 gpt-5.6-sol 不支持 /v1/chat/completions 接口，请改用 /v1/responses（OpenAI Responses API）。
```

而后台探针固定用 `/v1/chat/completions` 去测，所以每个模型必然 400。`usage.jsonl` 里能直接看到：

```json
{"t":"2026-10-26T15:33:01","provider":"agentrouter","model":"gpt-5.6-sol","status":400,"ep":"/v1/chat/completions","kind":"provider_test","source":"probe"}
{"t":"2026-10-26T15:33:01","provider":"agentrouter","model":"gpt-6-astra","status":400,"ep":"/v1/chat/completions","kind":"provider_test","source":"probe"}
{"t":"2026-10-26T15:33:01","provider":"agentrouter","model":"gpt-6.1-sol","status":400,"ep":"/v1/chat/completions","kind":"provider_test","source":"probe"}
```

（时间为便于阅读截短，其余字段原样）

## 同一批模型真实调用是通的

给 provider 配上 responses 端点：

```bash
magpie provider set agentrouter responses=https://agentrouter.org/v1
```

之后网关日志显示 magpie 自己就会把 chat 请求转过去：

```json
{"t":"2026-10-26T15:32:34","provider":"agentrouter","model":"gpt-6.1-sol","status":200,"ep":"/v1/chat/completions → /v1/responses"}
```

`/v1/chat/completions` 和 `/v1/messages` 两条路都能正常出结果，三个模型都测过。

## 试过但没用

- 只保留 responses、把 chat 端点清空（`magpie provider set agentrouter url=`）。探针仍然打 `/v1/chat/completions`，看起来是回落到默认地址了，红点照旧。
- `magpie provider test agentrouter` 本身逻辑是对的，会分别测 responses 和 anthropic，两项都通过：

```
✓ responses  2056 ms · gpt-5.6-sol
✓ anthropic  9992 ms · gpt-5.6-sol
```

但 Models 列表里的红点不跟着这个结果走。

## 期望

探针选端点时能参考 provider 实际配了什么：只有 `responses`（或者模型本身是 responses-only）时就打 `/v1/responses`，别写死 chat。或者干脆让 `provider test` 的结果成为列表里红绿点的依据，这样两处不会互相矛盾。

现在的状态是功能没坏、界面一直显示不可用，只能靠人记住别用 "Working only" 筛选。

issue.title: [Bug] Codex 主动取消请求被计入失败：子代理报告注入时的正常中断拉低成功率

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### 问题

Codex 多代理工作过程中，客户端可能为了接收子代理结果而主动中断正在进行的模型请求。Magpie 将这类请求记录为 `499 / the agent canceled the request`，并计入用量页的失败次数、降低成功率。

建议将「客户端取消」与「上游请求失败」分开统计。正常的代理调度中断不应被直接展示为服务失败。

### 实际观察（已脱敏）

环境：Codex 主代理通过 Magpie 调用 `gpt-6.1-sol`，同时有子代理运行。

下面是一条网关路由记录与本地 Codex 会话事件的对照。时间均改为相对时间，不包含会话 ID、请求 ID、账户身份、本地路径或任务内容：

| 相对时间 | 事件 |
| --- | --- |
| T+0.000s | Magpie 收到主代理的 Sol 请求 |
| T+4.401s | 本地会话记录子代理完成 |
| T+6.239s～T+18.337s | 本地会话记录该 Sol 回复的推理内容；可通过 response ID 与网关请求对应 |
| T+18.344s | 子代理最终报告注入主会话 |
| T+18.346s 左右 | 网关请求结束，记录 `499 / the agent canceled the request`，尝试分类为 `canceled` |
| T+34.531s | 主代理正常继续处理子代理结果，随后完成任务 |

这段上下文没有新的用户消息或用户手动停止事件。子代理报告注入与请求取消相差约 2ms，强烈支持「客户端为纳入子代理结果而中断当前请求」的解释。

证据边界：本地会话没有直接记录 HTTP 请求的内部取消原因，因此上述具体触发原因是基于时序和请求身份对应关系的推断；可以直接确认的是客户端取消、子代理报告同时到达，以及任务随后正常继续。

同一天，我们观察到失败汇总中的 92 次有 91 次属于 `499 / the agent canceled the request`，只有 1 次是最终回复中途断流。这里只逐条核对了上述实例的本地上下文，不能据此断定其余所有取消都来自子代理调度。尽管如此，把取消统一计入失败，会使失败次数和成功率很难反映实际的上游稳定性。

### 预期行为

- 客户端取消作为独立结果展示，仍可在请求列表和详情中追溯。
- 失败次数不把这类主动取消直接当作上游失败；成功率分母也应明确处理取消，避免将取消误算成成功。
- 真正的上游错误、EOF、超时等仍按相应结果统计；已有 Token / 费用记录应保留。

### 简短实现建议

网关已经有 `failCanceled` 分类，并在请求 context 取消且回复尚未结束时设置 499。可以沿用这一分类，为 usage 汇总增加独立的 canceled 结果，而不是让所有 `status >= 400` / error 非空记录统一增加 Errors。

重点检查 `internal/gateway/gateway.go` 的取消处理，以及 `internal/usage/usage.go` 中的 `Failed()`、`Totals.count()` 和成功率计算/失败筛选。若持久化记录没有显式取消类型，可考虑持久化该语义，避免仅凭任意 499 状态码猜测原因。

不建议把所有客户端取消直接改成成功，也不需要把上述具体调度原因当作已被网关证实。

issue.title: provider: Command Code 的 Credits 窗不显示重置时间——月度池按订阅周期回满，同卡其它窗都有 resets 行

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 现象

#2451 让 Command Code 的卡片（订阅卡与 plan key 卡）把月度 credits 画成 *Credits* meter，排在 5-hour 和 Weekly 两窗旁边。那两窗各自带「↻ resets …」行（卡片行、tooltip、菜单栏面板都读窗口的 `resetsAt`），Credits 一行却没有：月度 credits 恰恰是按订阅周期重置的，用户看不到它何时回来。同家族其它月度窗都有重置时间——Ollama Cloud 的 *Month* 窗接 `period.until`（readOllamaPlan）、StepFun 的 *Credits* 窗接 `subscription_credit_reset_time`（readStepPlan）、WorkBuddy 企业版接 `cycleResetTime`——唯独 Command Code 的没接。

## 最小复现

`TestCommandCodeCreditsWindowRenewsAtPeriodEnd`（新测试）在修复前的树上（1d227a7e）红：

```
--- FAIL: TestCommandCodeCreditsWindowRenewsAtPeriodEnd (0.00s)
    commandcode_key_credits_test.go:116: the key card's credits have no reset: {Name:Credits Used:47.8 ResetsAt:<nil> ...}
    commandcode_key_credits_test.go:128: the subscription card's credits have no reset: {Name:Credits Used:47.8 ResetsAt:<nil> ...}
```

假服务器按 #2451 测试同款形状回答 `billing/credits` 与 `billing/subscriptions`（后者带 `currentPeriodEnd`），分别走 `planKeyWindows`（key 卡）与 `cmdQuota`（订阅卡）。

## 根因

`internal/provider/commandcode_plan.go` 的 `cmdQuotaOf` 造 Credits 窗时不带重置时间：

```go
q.Windows = append(q.Windows, QuotaWindow{Name: "Credits", Used: min(100, 100*(pool-left)/pool),
    Display: money("$", pool-left) + " / " + money("$", pool)})
```

而两条调用路径手里都有周期端点：

- 订阅卡 `cmdQuota`：`cmdSubscription` 已返回 `until`（`billing/subscriptions` 的 `currentPeriodEnd`），只写进了 `q.Until`，没接到窗上；
- key 卡 `cmdKeyWindows`（#2451）：`cmdKeyPlanID` 调同一个 `cmdSubscription` 拿 plan id，把 `until` 扔掉了。

## 修法

`cmdQuotaOf` 加一个 `until *time.Time` 参数，Credits 窗带上 `ResetsAt: until`；两条路径各自把手里的周期端点传进来。key 卡侧 `cmdSeen` 增加 `until` 字段，`cmdKeyPlanID` 返回 `(id, until)`，缓存命中与读取失败时一并返回（和 id 的保留规则一致）。没有周期端点（`billing/subscriptions` 不可读）时窗上无重置，行为同修复前。

语义上 period end 就是月度池的重置点：Credits 窗的 `Used` 分子只反映月度 credits 的消耗（`pool-left = max(planMonthly, monthly) - monthly`），bought/free credits 只抬高分母，不随周期重置的部分不在这扇 meter 的读数里。

## 验证

| 检查 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `TestCommandCodeCreditsWindowRenewsAtPeriodEnd`（新） | 修复前红（上表输出），修复后绿 |
| 消融（产品文件回父提交 1d227a7e，旧调用点测试文件同回，新测试保留） | 红，失败断言与修前红同形 |
| `TestCommandCodeKeyCardHasCredits` / `TestKeyQuotasKeepLast` / `TestCommandCodeQuotaShowsWindows`（其两处 `cmdQuotaOf` 调用改传 `nil`） | 绿 |
| `go test -tags nogui -p 2 ./internal/provider/ ./internal/usage/ ./internal/catalog/` | 三包全 ok |
| `gofmt -l internal/` | 无输出 |
| `go vet`（darwin）与 `GOOS=linux go vet -tags nogui`、`GOOS=windows go vet` | 通过 |
| `go build`（darwin、linux nogui、windows） | 通过 |

issue.body:
provider: OpenCode 导入只认 19 个 id——zhipuai、zai、alibaba、minimax、kimi-code-plan 等 15 个 magpie 同址 preset 的 key 被误报“没有 base URL”跳过

## 现象

37fec124 把 OpenCode 的 `auth.json` 接进了导入选择器。`openCodePresets`（internal/provider/import_opencode.go）按它自己的注释规则工作——「OpenCode's provider ids by the magpie preset at the same address」——但表里只有 19 个 id。models.dev 目录（OpenCode 的 id 来源）里还有 15 个 id，其 api 主机就是 magpie 某个 preset 的默认地址，全部不在表里，于是在选择器里被列为「it has no base URL」跳过——这对它们是假话：magpie 明明有同址的 preset。

受影响最直接的人群：GLM/Z.ai、Qwen/DashScope、MiniMax、ModelScope、Kimi Code、StepFun、火山方舟、百炼/腾讯云 Token Plan、Kilo、ClinePass 的 OpenCode 用户——恰好是 magpie preset 覆盖最全的那批厂商。例如用 `opencode auth login` 登过 Zhipu GLM（id `zhipuai`）的用户，在导入选择器里看到的是一行「跳过：它没有 base URL」，只能手工重建 provider。

## 最小复现

`auth.json` 放一个 api 型条目（`XDG_DATA_HOME` 沙盒指向临时目录）：

```json
{ "zhipuai": { "type": "api", "key": "sk-zhipu-oc" } }
```

新测试 `TestImportOpenCodeVendorPresets`（15 个 id 逐个断言「落到同名 preset、无 skip」）在 37fec124 上全红：

```
--- FAIL: TestImportOpenCodeVendorPresets (0.00s)
    import_opencode_test.go:251: alibaba: skipped: it has no base URL
    import_opencode_test.go:251: alibaba-cn: skipped: it has no base URL
    import_opencode_test.go:251: cline-pass: skipped: it has no base URL
    import_opencode_test.go:251: kilo: skipped: it has no base URL
    import_opencode_test.go:251: kimi-code-plan-cn: skipped: it has no base URL
    import_opencode_test.go:251: kimi-code-plan-global: skipped: it has no base URL
    import_opencode_test.go:251: minimax: skipped: it has no base URL
    import_opencode_test.go:251: modelscope: skipped: it has no base URL
    import_opencode_test.go:251: stepfun-ai-step-plan: skipped: it has no base URL
    import_opencode_test.go:251: stepfun-step-plan: skipped: it has no base URL
    import_opencode_test.go:251: volcengine-coding-plan: skipped: it has no base URL
    import_opencode_test.go:251: zai: skipped: it has no base URL
    import_opencode_test.go:251: zhipuai: skipped: it has no base URL
    ...（alibaba-token-plan-cn、tencent-token-plan 同形，共 15 行）
```

## 根因

`openCodePresets`（internal/provider/import_opencode.go:34）漏了满足自己声明规则的 id。逐条对照 models.dev 的 `api` 字段（OpenCode 实际发往的地址，auth.json 只存 key 不存地址）与 magpie preset 的默认端点：

| OpenCode id | models.dev api | magpie preset（默认端点） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| zhipuai | open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4 | zhipu（同一 URL） |
| zai | api.z.ai/api/paas/v4 | zai（同一 URL） |
| alibaba | dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 | qwen（同一 URL） |
| alibaba-cn | dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 | qwen-cn（同一 URL） |
| minimax | api.minimax.io | minimax（api.minimax.io/v1 + /anthropic） |
| modelscope | api-inference.modelscope.cn/v1 | modelscope（同一 URL） |
| kilo | api.kilo.ai | kilo（api.kilo.ai/api/openrouter） |
| cline-pass | api.cline.bot/api/v1 | clinepass（同一 URL） |
| kimi-code-plan-cn | api.kimi.com/coding/v1 | kimi-code-cn（同一 URL） |
| kimi-code-plan-global | api.kimi.ai/coding/v1 | kimi-code（同一 URL） |
| stepfun-step-plan | api.stepfun.com/step_plan/v1 | stepfun-cn（同一 URL） |
| stepfun-ai-step-plan | api.stepfun.ai/step_plan/v1 | stepfun（同一 URL） |
| volcengine-coding-plan | ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/coding/v3 | volcengine（同一 URL） |
| alibaba-token-plan-cn | token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com | bailian-token-plan（同主机） |
| tencent-token-plan | api.lkeap.cloud.tencent.com | tencent-cloud（/plan/v3，同主机） |

对照规则的两个既有先例：已收录的 `opencode → opencode-zen` 也是主机级同址（models.dev 的 api 是 opencode.ai/inference/v1，preset 是 opencode.ai/zen/v1，路径不同）；commit 说明里 SiliconFlow 的 `.com` id 被排除是因为它对应 preset 的 intl **region**，而 auth.json 没有可用来选 region 的信息——上表 15 条不含任何 region 型匹配，preset 默认端点即该 id 的产品本体（Kimi Code/Step Plan/方舟 Coding Plan/两个 Token Plan 的 preset 默认端点本来就是其 plan 端点）。

## 修法

补齐 15 条映射，一行一个（patch 见下）。仍然排除、并在 commit message 里写明理由的：

- **需要选 region、auth.json 无从选起**（同 SiliconFlow `.com` 先例）：`zhipuai-coding-plan`、`zai-coding-plan`（各自 preset 的 plan region）、`minimax-coding-plan`、`stepfun`/`stepfun-ai`/`volcengine`（按量付费 id 落在 plan 优先的默认端点上）、`tencent-coding-plan`；
- **已迁社区插件的订阅**：`xiaomi-token-plan-*`（mimo-app）；
- 主机是 `localhost` 的 `privatemode-ai` 无对应本体。

| 项 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| TestImportOpenCodeVendorPresets（新，15 id 表驱动） | 37fec124 上红：15 行 `skipped: it has no base URL`；补映射后绿 |
| 消融复核 | `git stash -- internal/provider/import_opencode.go` 后重跑：15 行同形红；pop 后绿 |
| TestImportOpenCodeAuth / AuthWithoutXDG / AuthUnknown（既有夹具） | 绿，`len(items) != 7` 等既有断言未动 |
| go test -tags nogui -count=1 ./internal/provider（全包） | ok |
| gofmt -l internal/ | 干净 |
| go vet（darwin -tags nogui、GOOS=linux -tags nogui、GOOS=windows） | 干净 |
| go build darwin / GOOS=linux -tags nogui / GOOS=windows | ok |

models.dev 数据取自 2026-10-15 抓取的 <https://models.dev/api.json>（230 个 provider，id 与 api 字段逐条核对）。

## 没跑什么

- GUI playwright（import-opencode.test.cjs 等）：本 patch 不触 GUI 代码与任何 i18n 字符串，夹具里的既有行不变；新 id 的行渲染与既有 vendor 行同一代码路径。
- 真机 OpenCode：15 个 id 的 key 未逐一在对应厂商真实服务上验证连通（导入只是把 key 放到 preset 的既有端点上，端点本身是 magpie 既有测过的）；zhipuai/zai 落在按量付费默认端点，plan key 走 1113 → RetryZhipuCoding 的既有自愈路径，未实测。
- Windows 桌面端手工验证（路径逻辑与 37fec124 相同，未改动）。

issue.body:
# provider: Antigravity 池的 7 天窗口收不到重置提醒——aside 一刀切挡掉了 #523 明确要告知的窗口 基线：`331c2770`（分支 `hunt19-b-pool-reminder`，提交 `5fe77cb0`）。发稿前已再 fetch upstream：tip 前进到 `b7a2e7376`（新增 8 个 commit），`git diff 331c2770 b7a2e7376 -- internal/provider/quota_alert.go` 为空，缺陷仍在，patch 可直接 apply。 ## 现象 开了 Settings › Usage 的 Reset reminder（如 24h）后，Antigravity 账号的池周窗口（"Gemini · 7 days"、"Claude & GPT · 7 days"）**永远不会**触发"窗口将续期、还剩很多"的提醒——哪怕它只用了 40%、20 小时后就清零续期。而同一个窗口的**用量警报**是正常的：用到 80% 会响（#523 特意让警报告知它）。 后果：用户对池周窗口"只被告知用得多了，从不知道快清零了"。同一账号、同一个 7 天窗口，两套通知对它说的是两套话。若同样的窗口出现在没有 aside 标记的厂商（Codex 的 7 days），40% 剩余 + 20h 续期会正常提醒。 说明：这是机制推演 + 单元级复现，没有真实 Antigravity 账号的端到端通知截图；池窗口的形状（aside、weekly、带 ResetTime）以仓内 `TestDueAlertsPoolWindows` 记录的厂商真实报告为准（该测试注释："the windows Antigravity really reports"）。 ## 最小复现 新增 `TestDueRemindersPoolWeekly`（`internal/provider/quota_alert_test.go`）：给 `dueReminders` 喂 Antigravity 真实报告形状的窗口——池周窗口（`Pool: "Gemini", Span: 7d, Aside: true, Used: 40, ResetsAt: 20h 后`）和池 5 小时窗口——提醒开 24h。修前（把 `quota_alert.go` 的判定还原为 `w.Aside || …`）： ```text --- FAIL: TestDueRemindersPoolWeekly (0.00s) quota_alert_test.go:217: got [] FAIL FAIL github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/provider 0.992s ``` 即：还剩 60% 的周窗口在提醒窗口期内一言不发。修后同测试绿：周窗口报一次 `renews`（名字是池化的 "Gemini · 7 days"），同 run 不重报；5 小时池窗口仍然不报；用到 90% 的周窗口也不报（没什么可挽回，#720 原意）。 ## 根因 `internal/provider/quota_alert.go`，`dueReminders`： ```go for _, w := range PooledWindows(q.Windows) { if w.Aside || w.Span < reminderSpan || w.Used >= reminderUnder { continue } ``` `w.Aside` 一刀切。但 Antigravity 的池窗口在 `google.go` 的 `pools()` 里天生 `Aside: true`（注释："They are Aside: routing goes on reading the per-model windows"），经 `PooledWindows` 替换后，这个账号在提醒路径上能看到的 ≥1 天窗口**只有**池周窗口——全被 `w.Aside` 挡掉，5 小时池窗口再被 `reminderSpan` 挡掉，于是该账号的 renews 提醒永远为零。 对照：一天前的 #523（29a14c9a）给 `dueAlerts` 定下的豁免是有声明的——commit 原文 "A pool's weekly window is aside (using it up doesn't stop the account) but is still told of; the pools' 5-hour asides aren't"，且有 `TestDueAlertsPoolWindows` 守护。#720（6e500cb52）次日写 `dueReminders` 时只声明了两个排除理由（5 小时窗口 "renews too often to be news"、用满 ≥85% "little is lost"），aside 不在其列；`TestDueReminders` 也没有任何 aside 断言——是沉默，不是有意守护。两处遍历的是同一个 `PooledWindows` 集合，判定却分了叉。 ## 修法 把 #523 的豁免提成两处共用的谓词 `toldAside(w)`（`w.Pool != "" && w.Span == 7*24*time.Hour`），`dueAlerts` 原条件换成它（行为不变），`dueReminders` 的 `w.Aside` 换成 `w.Aside && !toldAside(w)`： - 池周窗口进入提醒判定（span 7d ≥ 24h 自然通过，used < 85% 时报）； - 池 5 小时窗口双重挡住（aside 非周 + span < 24h），#720 "太频繁"的原意不变； - on-demand/Copilot 补全等其余 aside 窗口照旧不提醒。 不扩范围：不给"所有 aside 且 ≥1 天"的窗口开提醒（#523 只声明了池周窗口这一类）；不动 `codex_warmup.go`/`codex_autoreset.go` 里的 aside 判定（Codex 读数不产池窗口，无此形态）。提醒的 key、once-per-run 语义、marks 文件都不变。 ## 验证 | 命令 | 结果 | | --- | --- | | 修前（判定还原 `w.Aside ||`）跑 `TestDueRemindersPoolWeekly` | FAIL：`got []`（真实断言失败） | | 修后同测试 | PASS（报一次、不重报、5h 与 90% 不报） | | 有牙检查：再摘掉修复 | 回红：`got []` | | `go test -tags nogui -p 2 -count=1 ./internal/provider/`（沙盒 HOME） | ok 72.486s（含既有 `TestDueAlertsPoolWindows`、`TestDueReminders`，均未改断言） | | `gofmt -l internal/` | 无输出 | | `go vet -tags nogui ./internal/provider/`（darwin / GOOS=linux）+ `GOOS=windows go vet ./internal/provider/` | 三个 exit 0 | | `go build -o /dev/null .`（darwin）| OK（仅已知 ld macOS 版本警告） | | `GOOS=linux go build -tags nogui -o /dev/null .` | OK | | `GOOS=windows go build -o /dev/null .` | OK | **没跑什么**：没有真实 Antigravity 账号的通知端到端（`pools()` 的 HTTP 形状由 `TestAntigravityQuotaPools` 系列守护，本单只动其后的判定）；GUI/TUI/CLI 不涉及（它们只显示 pooled 窗口，不过滤 aside）；`internal/gateway` 及其它包未跑全量——改动是 provider 包内未导出函数，无 API 变化，三平台 vet/build 已覆盖编译面。既有测试断言零改动（仅新增一个测试）。 ## 补丁与分支 - 分支：https://github.com/ggbdpq/magpie/tree/hunt19-b-pool-reminder（基 `331c2770`，`git am` 可用） -

issue.body: 把上游 v0.1.1969（5637cca1，从 v0.1.1551 起 577 个提交）合进 fork，并补上这次同步带出来的两件 fork 自己的事。共三个提交，每个提交的说明里都写了跑过哪些检查。 ## 提交 - `257a4ea3 sync: 合入上游 v0.1.1969`（merge commit，父提交 b378c20a 和 5637cca1） - 17 处冲突，每处的解法写在提交说明里。 - 上游 #3568/#3451 自己做了交接时停止 accept、`Connection: close` 和等未读请求，覆盖了 fork 的 `handover_fork.go`，所以删掉这个文件、它的测试和 `gateway.go` 里的两处钩子。`handoff_fork_unix.go`（`Give` 不改阻塞模式）保留。 - 上游 #3632 做了和 fork 一样的 `filememo` 按需建 channel，这里用上游的实现，fork 测试保留。 - 新增一个 fork 钩子：上游 #3185 让 `refreshDueLists` 自己读 providers.json，读到的行没有 life 标记。现在用 `lifeLoad()` 读并打上标记，新测试 `TestAScheduledFetchDropsPicksOnlyOfTheProviderItRead` 去掉钩子后会变红。 - 钩子审计（对 origin/main b378c20a）：`fork:` 标记 120 → 114，差的几处都说明了；其余关键钩子数量不变。上游新增的 provider 写入都走 `store` 或 `Save`。 - `dc6de1f7 update: fork 也按 Settings 的 Stable 更新渠道挑版本` - 以前：上游新加的「更新渠道 → Stable」在 fork 上不起作用，因为 fork 直接列 GitHub releases，选了 Stable 也会收到每个 rc。 - 现在：`stableOf` 按上游 `site/worker.js` 的规则从 fork 自己的 releases 里挑版本：每周一 00:00 UTC 换一次，取那之前三天就已发布的最新版；版本说明里有 `**Urgent release:**` 的版本立刻生效。没有可选的版本时报错说明原因。默认渠道不变。 - `f45d6fc3 gui: About 页在上游的 Website 行下加 fork 的 Releases 行` - 上游的 Website 行指向 usemagpie.ai，那里的下载是上游的构建。这一行保留不动，下面加一行 Releases，指向 `update.Downloads`（fork 的 Releases 页）。 - 代码和五种语言的文字放在 fork 自己的 `releases.js` 里，`app.js` 只加了一行钩子。`forkScriptBudget` 54,260 → 55,890。 ## 验证 细节见各提交的说明。概括如下： - gofmt 为空，vet 在 linux、windows、darwin 三个系统下都通过。 - 在 Windows 上逐个包跑：update、filememo、handoff、identity、backup、lifecycle 都 ok。provider、cli、gateway 里剩下的红在纯 v0.1.1969 上也红（Windows 专有问题：`TCPListener.File`、TempDir 被占用等）。 - break check：autolist 钩子、Stable 条件、Releases 钩子都手动改坏过，对应的测试都真的报 FAIL。 - GUI：改动涉及的文件在 chromium 和 webkit 上都通过（webkit 的 update-channel 在负载下红过一次，单独重跑 11/11）。`about-releases.test.cjs` 覆盖两个引擎、五种语言和窄窗口。 - GUI 全量：本地正在跑（两个引擎），这是第一份基线，跑完后结果补在这里。 - Go 全量由这个 PR 的 CI 跑。 没用真实的 GitHub releases 跑过 Stable 检查。按 fork 现有的 release，本周的 Stable 应是 v0.1.1318-rc.0。合并后的 tag（v0.1.1969-rc.0）另行确认。 --- ### 🎬 界面预览 CI 用这个 PR 的代码构建并真实运行 magpie（沙盒环境，配置了真实的 DeepSeek key），按改动自动操作、截图和录屏 · f45d6fc · [运行记录](https://github.com/lauchiwa/magpie/actions/runs/40824089767) 这次没录成（skipped）。详见[运行记录](https://github.com/lauchiwa/magpie/actions/runs/40824089767)。
